verdict.rationale: A state business-filing commission's web presence could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no sign of either. The only probes are robots.txt files that disallow all crawling on the SCC and CIS hosts, so the hosts were never fetched beyond those files and no agent-oriented documentation was observed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
